The '''Jaso sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. It was a significant medical area in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]] had an important laboratory there, where both [[Cinto Alaras]] and [[Sommen]] worked.
